name: Solvalley School
source:
The novel deals with the adventures of Alex, a young student at local school. It is up to the player to develop Alex's abilities to try and win as many girls as possible.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/tkcorp8000]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
小说讲述了当地学校的年轻学生亚历克斯的冒险经历。玩家需要培养亚历克斯的能力，尝试赢得尽可能多的女孩。

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/tkcorp8000]Patreon[/url]]
